title: nf-core/gwas pipeline - cohort manifest schema
description: Schema for the cohort manifest provided with params.cohort_manifest. One row declares one cohort-owned PLINK 2 or PLINK 1 genotype representation.

cohort_id.description: Unique identifier for the cohort and the key used by the analysis manifest.
cohort_id.errorMessage: Cohort ID must be provided, must be unique across the cohort manifest and cannot contain spaces

genome_build.description: Genome build of the cohort genotypes.
genome_build.errorMessage: Genome build must be one of 'GRCh37' or 'GRCh38'

ancestry.description: Case-sensitive ancestry label carried through to output provenance.
ancestry.errorMessage: Ancestry must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots and dashes

pgen.description: PLINK 2 genotype file for the cohort.
pgen.errorMessage: PLINK 2 genotype file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.pgen'

psam.errorMessage: PLINK 2 sample file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.psam'

pvar.errorMessage: PLINK 2 variant file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.pvar'; a Zstandard-compressed '.pvar.zst' is not supported because the pipeline's PLINK 2, GCTA and REGENIE consumers derive a bare --pfile prefix and do not pass the 'vzs' modifier

bed.description: PLINK 1 genotype file for the cohort. Supply together with bim and fam.
bed.errorMessage: PLINK 1 genotype file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.bed'

bim.errorMessage: PLINK 1 variant file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.bim'

fam.errorMessage: PLINK 1 sample file cannot contain spaces, must exist and must have extension '.fam'

genotype_view_id.description: Optional immutable identity of the supplied genotype view: a lowercase hexadecimal digest you computed over the supplied files, or the content-addressed view identity written by a genotype backend launcher, optionally prefixed by that backend's namespace (for example 'biofuse:'). When absent, the pipeline digests the supplied file bytes once per cohort.
genotype_view_id.errorMessage: genotype_view_id must be 16 to 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, optionally prefixed by a backend namespace such as 'biofuse:'
